records.head: # §A · ORIENTATION — the whole project in one page
records.text:
# §A · ORIENTATION — the whole project in one page

> **Why this file is called GOOD-MORNING** *(Dave's framing — keep it, it explains the architecture)*
> **Memento.** Leonard has anterograde amnesia: every morning he reconstitutes himself from a record he
> built when he still remembered — Polaroids for working state, **tattoos for the facts he cannot afford
> to lose**. That is this project's operating model, not a metaphor for it. A session starts with no
> memory and rebuilds from artefacts.
>
> **The trust hierarchy is the tattoo/Polaroid distinction:** repo rules + runbooks + ledgers = tattoos
> (durable, survive any single rewrite) · `GOOD-MORNING` + `_LIVE-STATE` = Polaroids (working state,
> rewritten often) · the chat = gone by morning. **Never let a durable rule live only on a Polaroid.**
> *(Live example, 2026-07-22: this file said the tabs ruling was "NOT yet inscribed" — the ledger already
> carried R-D23 AND R-D24. The ledger was right. Read the ledger.)*
>
> **The real danger is not forgetting — it is confident false inscription.** Records carry provenance
> and confidence, not just content. Corrections get inscribed as loudly as the original claim. **Mark
> what was OBSERVED versus what was INFERRED.** The ritual stamps dates from `date`, never from belief.
> *(2026-07-22 afternoon instance: B-D7 was ruled in TWO beats — "shared 4%", reversed within the hour
> to pixel-true. BOTH are in the ledger, so the reversal can never read as agent drift.)*
>
> **The SECOND failure mode costs more: a stale READING of our own rules.** ⇒ **Before designing anything,
> CONSULT: `python3 knowledge/_consult.py "<what you're about to design>"`** (rules · rulings · assertions ·
> gates + where each bites). Runbook: `knowledge/_RUNBOOK-consult.md`. *(ds-009 CLOSED 2026-07-22: the
> corpus is now DISCOVERED — every `_proforma/_*-DECISIONS.md` indexes or the build fails.)*

> **STANDING SECTION — carry it into every handoff, from 2026-07-17 on.** At Dave's request:
> *"orientate a new starter — wider context helps."* New-starter style: assume the reader has no context.
> **Update it when the shape of the project changes, not every session — but never drop it, and never
> shorten it to a label.** *(Also step 2 of `_RUNBOOK-capture-ritual.md`; reachability-gated by
> `_validate_standing_instructions.py`.)*

records.head: ## What Apollo is
records.text:
## What Apollo is
A **governed design-system engine** for agentic UI generation. The bet: *generation is a commodity* — the value
is the layer around any generator. Two principles run through everything:
- **Retrieval, not recall.** Brand values are retrieved from token stores, so generated work can't drift off-brand.
  **Since ADR-0013 (built 2026-07-22) retrieval reaches RULES too:** organisms consume atoms' rule-blocks
  as generated partials — never re-type a sub-atom.
- **Verification = enforcement.** Judgment is encoded as **blocking gates**; "done" is withheld until they pass.
  If a rule isn't gated, assume it will be broken.

Tagline: **"lovable on rails."** Four phases: **Discover** → **Create** (what's being built now) → **Craft**
(the review-overlay docs ARE this) → **Dispatch**.

records.head: ## ★ ONE token store · ONE baseline library · FOUR themes (R-D15 → ADR-0011 → ADR-0014 → ★ ADR-0013)
records.text:
## ★ ONE token store · ONE baseline library · FOUR themes (R-D15 → ADR-0011 → ADR-0014 → ★ ADR-0013)
*Themes are **override sets at the semantic tier**; since ADR-0014 they carry **their own neutral primitive
ramps** through the **neutral DNA tier** (semantic roles alias `color/neutral/1–15`, never `color/mono/*`
directly; indices are SEMANTIC POSITIONS — SC remaps its anchor). **State mechanism is a THEME PROPERTY**
(registry `stateMechanism` + blocking snap gate). **★ Since ADR-0013, MOTION is a theme dial too (B-D7):**
`motion/press/{travel,darken}` — Mono carries the movement (pixel-true 2px), **Console inherits it**,
**Legacy + Supercharge zero it** (colour-only state feedback); tuning = a token edit, zero JS.
**Sibling pairs:** {Mono, Console} share neutrals/opacity/status/dataviz — Console FENCED (colour;
motion is inherited-not-fenced, flag if it should join); {Legacy, Supercharge} = structural siblings.*
The four themes (Dave's canonical order):
- **Apollo Legacy** — faithful reproduction of the existing HSBC system: brand red `#DB0011`, teals,
  `color/grey/*`. **AA-EXEMPT as-built (R-D24)**; explicit per-path overrides, no DNA tier, **no press movement**.
- **★ Apollo Mono** — the baseline we build NOW. "Very mono": colour ONLY in RAG status + dataviz.
  Neutral scale = `color/mono/1–15`; only red `#B92F1E` (status/RAG/dataviz). Carries the B-D7 press physics.
- **Apollo Console** — branded HSBC library. **LOCKED ≡ Mono** on neutrals/opacity/status/dataviz (fence);
  inherits Mono's motion; live divergence = rounded corners (radius overrides, values provisional).
- **Apollo Supercharge** — brand-uplift. **OWN warm ramp** `color/warm/1–15` (OBSERVED, Figma pull);
  states = COLOUR; **no press movement**; dark mode = provisional-agent, awaiting Dave.

records.head: ## Rules that actually bite (core + this session's)
records.text:
## Rules that actually bite (core + this session's)
- **CONSULT before designing** — then **survey before build**. *(This session the survey found Icon-button's
  physics was a REVIEWED refinement, not drift — which became B-D7.)*
- **★ ADR-0013 (BUILT): never re-type a sub-atom.** A registered partial's rule may exist ONLY in the
  atom's PARTIAL block or a generated AUTO-PARTIAL block — the ratchet gate blocks members' local
  re-implementations; the census lists everyone else's (accrete from OBSERVED duplication, ruling 3).
  Joining a family = markers + required vars + manifest binds + registry entry, and the generator
  fails loud on any missing piece.
- **★ B-D7: press physics is pixel-true and theme-dialable.** Travel/darken are TOKENS
  (`motion/press/*` → group caches); `--phys-size` is LOCAL geometry (buttons 120, icon 44); Legacy/SC
  zero the dial. **No JS in physics — ever** (Dave's constraint; DEF-003 posture). Tuning = token edit.
- **ADR-0014: semantic neutrals alias `color/neutral/*`, NEVER `color/mono/*` directly** · whites are
  classified (substrate → `neutral/15`; absolute → `color/white`, pinned).
- **ADR-0014: opacity states must SNAP** (`_validate_state_snap.py`, blocking, 7 checks incl. the
  text-state AA floor — inactive ≠ disabled).
- **Selftests are BUILD STEPS** — every new gate ships one AND wires it (partials + ratchet did).
- **Resurrect-verbatim is NOT gate-exempt** — the 273d18c~1 stepper's 13px/3px hit the grid gate on
  re-entry; corrected 12px/4px. Old reviewed artefacts re-enter through the same door as new work.
- **Grey-tint standing check** · **type26-013 (BLOCKING): white type is red-only** · **R-D6 glyph
  contrast by ROLE** · **`LEGACY_THEME_EXEMPTIONS`** (R-D24 — EXEMPTED, never passed).
- **canon.css** — generated only between AUTO markers; type.css HAND-AUTHORED. *(The ruling-4 gap is
  CLOSED: snippet RULE-text now self-heals into canon every build.)*
- **Every selector appended to `canon/type.css` is GLOBAL** — register in `_type-bindings.json` or the
  blast-radius gate fails.
- **Icons: real assets only** · **4px grid** · **sentence case** · **square corners in Mono** (radius =
  ROLE tokens, per-theme) · **weights: 100/300/400/500/700 only, NO 600.**
- **Derivation governance** — the engine never derives-and-promotes. **Promotion is Dave's alone.**
  *(SC dark values agent-derived → AWAIT him; B-D7's enacted values are HIS ruling, verbatim-quoted.)*
- **Spine discipline** — state lines in `_LIVE-STATE`; narrative >10 lines → `_DECISION-HISTORY/`.
- **Inscription prose is PARSER-VISIBLE** — no node names in ADR-header parentheticals (phantom edges).

## Standing instructions for the agent
- **Announce the model/routing split at the START of every substantive task** (`MODEL-ROUTING.md`).
- **Surface the chat names at BOTH ends — the small reliable thing Dave leans on, and it gets dropped

  ready-to-paste **"Rename this chat: …"**; at WRAP, put BOTH names at the top of `GOOD-MORNING.md`
  (ritual step 4b). Claude cannot rename chats itself — a name left unsurfaced is a label lost.
- **Verify before asking** (read repo / run gates) — including your own flags. **Reflect back before
  recording** a ruling — and when a ruling REVERSES, inscribe both beats (B-D7 is the model).
- **Decision-heavy / material-referring choices ship as review HTML** (`knowledge/_review/_make_review.py`
  — NOT at knowledge/ root). Architecture calls = the ADR-0012/0013/0014 model: options + firm
  recommendations in-chat, Dave rules by number, inscribe same hour, **feed the graph seed same hour**.
- **Surface spin-off candidates**; register ideas in `_FUTURE-STATE.md`. **Run the capture ritual
  unasked**; **stamp dates from `date`**. **Memory accelerates; the repo is the record.**
- **Stamp the context-gauge reading on every handoff artefact** — creator in `GOOD-MORNING` commit-state,
  workers in their receipt header — as a SCRUTINY indicator on that artefact (Red-authored ⇒ next reader
  re-verifies before trusting; not a quality score). Canon: `_RUNBOOK-context-gauge.md` § authoring-time stamp.

rulings mid-flight — receipt verbatim.

## How we work
- **Review loop:** every doc ships **clean source + REVIEW copy** (`knowledge/_review/_make_review.py <file>`).
- **Live tuners beat static versions past ~2 colour round-trips.** Sheets read canon.css LIVE, never retype.
- **Dave commits via GitHub Desktop.** Claude commits in-sandbox per `_RUNBOOK-git-commit.md` — run it,
  don't improvise. `unable to unlink … *.lock` warnings = the delete-guard, not failure; judge by HEAD.

> ## ★ PRIOR — 2026-07-27 (Mon **afternoon #9**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **ds-019 WITHDRAWN WITH CAUSE: THERE IS NO OVERRIDING RULE, AND THERE NEVER WAS** · ★ **the defect was the INSTRUMENT — a computed value read in the SAME TASK as the class change is the PRE-transition value** · ★ **`oklab(0 0 0 / 0)` is an IN-FLIGHT INTERPOLATION, not a failed declaration** · ★ **the predecessor probe's control WAS WORKING and was overruled as a string artefact** · ★ **DV-D17's render-proof UNBLOCKED · Dave's screenshot question ANSWERED** · harness given a REPO HOME by Dave's ruling · build untouched **60/60 GREEN** · 🔴 ~63% by his "headline only" call): **A false defect spent one full session as canon, and the record was directing the next window to hunt a rule that does not exist.**
> - **★ ds-019 IS NOT A DEFECT.** `.dv-legrow.is-solo` **(0,2,0) at cascade index 4** beats `.dv-legrow` **(0,1,0) at index 3** — CDP `getMatchedStylesForNode`, no `!important`, no inline, no `attributesStyle`, no keyframes, **no `:is()`/`:where()` or `#cb4-legend li` rule.** Confirmed in **six contexts**: snippet @1180/@760 · showroom light pane @1180/@760 · showroom **dark** pane @1180/@760 (theme-tracks correctly — `--ink` `#FFFFFF`, 6% white). **The census that found only four `dv-legrow` selectors was right; the premise it answered was false.**
> - **★ THE MECHANISM, measured as a time series.** `.dv-legrow` carries `transition: border-color var(--ease), background var(--ease)` = **0.16s**. Before add: `rgb(225,225,225)` / `rgba(0,0,0,0)` · **t=0 same task: `rgb(225,225,225)` / `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)`** ← *exactly the pair ds-019 recorded as proof* · t≈50ms: `rgb(145,145,145)` / `oklab(0.217785 … / 0.0241082)` **(mid-interpolation)** · **t≈150ms+: `rgb(26,26,26)` = `--ink` ✓ / 6% ink ✓.** **It paints from ~160ms.**
> - **★ THE HARDEST PART: THE PREDECESSOR'S POSITIVE CONTROL WAS WORKING.** It saw `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)` differ from `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` and passed — and those **genuinely are different states** (transitioning-transparent vs static-transparent). Session #8 diagnosed its own control as a string-comparison defect and **dismissed a true signal**. The string method was bad *and* its verdict was right. ⇒ **When a control fires unexpectedly, exhaust "it detected something real" BEFORE concluding it is broken.** Sibling of [[gate-narrows-its-own-rule]] and #7's stale suite — **the instrument present, correct-looking, and not measuring what it claimed** — except this one **got inscribed into the corpus as a defect and began directing work.**
> - **✅ DV-D17 UNBLOCKED + DAVE'S QUESTION ANSWERED.** The render-proof was blocked only by ds-019's premise. **DV-D17 stays ENACTED · DOM-PROVEN · RENDER-OWED** — prove it, don't rebuild it, and **settle the transition or you reproduce ds-019 exactly.** His logged question — *"if it never painted, what did the screenshot show?"* — **it showed the treatment, because the treatment paints. Screenshot right, probe wrong, two sessions. No silent regression.**
> - **★ RULED BY DAVE #9 — RENDER TOOLING GETS A REPO HOME.** The prior handoff said *"the harness is already written — reuse it, don't rebuild it"* pointing at `outputs/_render-env/probe.py`. **That was never followable: `outputs/` is `.gitignore` line 45.** Now `knowledge/_render/cdp_matched_styles.py` — CDP cascade enumeration, colours parsed **as colours**, **`--settle off` by default** (injects `transition:none !important` *before* the class change, making a mid-transition read structurally impossible); `--settle none` reproduces the artefact on demand. Pothole banked in `_RUNBOOK-render-verify.md`.
> - **⚠ ds-018 IS NOT WITHDRAWN — and NOT re-verified.** Same probe, same session. It measured a **resting** disabled control (not a post-class-change state) and its census is independent (**29 declarations, ten form scopes, zero chart scopes**), so the timing defect should not reach it. **"Should not" is not "does not" — a cheap re-check is OWED** (§C·4). **I skipped it deliberately at ~55% rather than start a fresh measurement hot.**

- **★★ FOUND — `HOLE #35` was a claim about the LOG being read as a claim about the SESSION.** #37 declared it honestly and was right to refuse reconstruction. But #35's post-mortem **was never missing**: it sat in `GOOD-MORNING.md` §C, written in the moment by the session that paid the cost — **only the 2f split's log half had failed.** #38's roll therefore **RECOVERED real testimony** (the `#28 — RECOVERED at #30's audit` precedent), and `HOLE #35` is **DISCHARGED BY ADDITION with the original text left verbatim** — it was true of the file when written. ⚠ **`HOLE #36` stands permanently:** neither half ran, so nothing exists to recover. ⇒ **Before declaring a HOLE, check the OTHER half of the split.** Evidence: `notes/_GAUGE-LOG.md` § META #38 + the `#### 2026-07-29 #35` block at its EOF.

A grep found no standing home; §C·4's retrieval-gap line covers `docs/decisions/` alone. **Copied up first, then rolled.** ⚠ **Sharpest instance of the class yet: the unreachable file is the ledger `ds-023` and `ds-025` live in**, so a session searching for the throttle's own open items finds nothing. Home: `GOOD-MORNING.md` §C·4 ⚠ RETRIEVAL GAP #2 [born #38].
- **★ MEASURED — a THIRD GM budget was nearly out and nobody was watching it.** The brief priced two, both confirmed: compactable **11,683 tape / 317 to block** · M10 chain **5,110 tape over its 4,500 warn**. **Unflagged: the BANNER region at 3,963 against a 4,000 WARN — 37 tape.** ⇒ **the rolls pay for the writing; run 2c/2d/2e/2f BEFORE authoring.** After the rolls the region had real room and the header came down as the banner went in. Evidence: `_capture_gate.py --wrap` at the opener, before any edit.
- **★ HOLE #37 DECLARED — and a state the vocabulary does not have, RAISED not filled.** #37 flushed at Amber and handed over mid-flight: **no closed band exists to record**, yet it left real MEASURED numbers (flush decision ~55%, full wrap priced ~73%). It fits neither `block`, nor `HOLE` in #36's sense, nor `ABSENT`. **Dave ruled `HOLE` for now because it invents nothing; the fourth state is his** (§C·4, sixth open). ⚠ A block with measured fields and `UNKNOWN` for the close would be **a new state minted by an agent** — ds-023 is the standing cautionary case.

Struck in place: disk half **17,810 tape / ~14.0 pts** MEASURED · harness half **UNREACHABLE, UNKNOWN** = `ds-025`. ⇒ **a fill term is part-measured, part-estimate and cannot honestly be called either alone.**

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-29 (Wed **morning #37**, OPUS solo, Dave live + a second lane of his running — ★★ **the band is ENACTED** · ★★ **ds-022's BLOCKING continuity gate has been unable to fire since #34: it took its clock from the ritual step it audits** · ★★ **`BANNER_SESSION_RE` had NEVER worked and a fallback hid it** · ★ **the BOOT is measured, first time in 36 sessions** · 🟡 SPINE-FLUSH ONLY, session continues) — "An auditor may not take its clock from the artefact it audits."

> ⚠ **THIS IS AN AMBER SPINE-FLUSH (capture-ritual STEP 1 ONLY), NOT A WRAP.** Ruled tier, `_RUNBOOK-context-gauge.md` § The trigger. Dave chose it at ~55% when the runbook read (**10,327 tape / ~8.1 pts**) plus execution priced the full wrap at **~73%** — past his own 63. **GOOD-MORNING.md is deliberately NOT written; no rename; no fresh window opened.** What is OWED to the fresh window is listed at the bottom of this delta.

- **★★ ENACTED — ds-023 IS NOW A BAND, in code.** Dave's #36 ruling, unenacted for a session, is live: `BAND_FLOOR/HARD_STOP/MARKED_MAX = (45, 60, 63)`, `PREFLIGHT_CEILING` **deleted**. `45–60` passes clean and is *named* the target; `61–63` needs `RESERVE SPEND — forked to Dave`; **`>63` is UNRULED and the gate says so out loud** rather than inventing a stop. ★ The 57% control fixture has now **flipped twice** — passed at birth, failed from #34, passes again — and is kept LIVE as the evidence that only the ENFORCEMENT ever moved. Ledger: `_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md` ds-023.
- **★★ FOUND + FIXED — the guard on `_GAUGE-LOG.md` could not fire, and had not since #34.** `gauge_log_continuity` is BLOCKING; it read the session number from the **§C stratum key**, written by **ritual step 2f — the very step whose omission it exists to catch.** #36 skipped 2f ⇒ clock froze at #35 ⇒ it asked *"does #34 have a block?"*, found one, and reported **"the 2f split landed"** while **#35 AND #36 were both missing from the log**. ★ **It does not self-correct: the clock stops at the last compliant session and reports GREEN for as long as the lapse runs.** Fixed: banner is the source, stratum is a CROSS-CHECK, and **banner≠stratum is itself a FAIL** — that disagreement *is* the signal 2f was skipped.
- **★★ AND THE FIX EXPOSED A SECOND DEFECT IN THE SAME WINDOW.** Promoting the banner revealed **`BANNER_SESSION_RE` had never worked**: unanchored, it matched **PROSE** mentioning "★ LATEST" in GM's header and returned **#29**. ★ **A fallback path is UNTESTED CODE until something forces it** — a broken primary sat behind a working secondary for as long as the secondary kept winning. Third substring-vs-structure defect here (#35's usage probe · ds-016's index): **match the STRUCTURE, not the words.** Now anchored to the blockquoted heading, with the decoy line baked into the fixture.
- **★ MEASURED — THE BOOT, for the first time in 36 sessions.** Disk-resident half alone: **17,810 tape / ~27,961 bill / ~14.0 pts** (`MEMORY.md` 4,517 · `available_skills` from 37 SKILL.md 5,684 · GM 1–120 6,253 · LS delta 1,356). ⚠ **The harness half is UNREACHABLE from inside** — the transcript is outside every sandbox mount. Inherited figure was *"~17 of a ~20-pt floor"* for the WHOLE boot ⇒ **either the harness half is implausibly small, or every pre-flight here has under-priced its floor.** Two consequences: **`MEMORY.md` (4,517) is bigger than the entire contract-priced read chain (4,194)** — eleven sessions cut the chain and nobody priced the index in front of it; and **the chain as actually read is 7,609 tape, not the header's 4.1K** — the header is right about GM 1–21 + LS delta, but the contract text sits at line 111, *below* the worklist, so nobody can reach it without paying 3,415 tape the contract does not count.
- **★ RAISED AS ds-025 (NEW) — the three load-bearing numbers are all unobservable from inside.** boot · `bill` · `fill`. `_GAUGE-LOG.md` has **never held a single `tape`/`bill` pair** (`grep -i bill` → 0, all sessions), so ds-021(c)'s n≥4 trigger has never advanced past the original **n=2**; the gate's own header admits it cannot see `fill`. **A number the instrument cannot observe will be supplied by estimate forever.** Three options written up, **none chosen** — (a) Dave-supplied inputs like the pace panel, (b) REFUSE rather than estimate, (c) publish the MEASURED/ESTIMATED split. ⚠ ds-023 is the cautionary case for letting an agent pick.
- **DATA REPAIR — `HOLE #35` and `HOLE #36` declared, NOT back-filled.** Both sessions' post-mortems are absent. #37 could have written plausible blocks from their dossiers; **that would forge the dataset the throttle is re-derived from.** HOLE is a positive claim that we know the gap is there. ⚠ #35's is a **half-done 2f split** — GM stratum written, log half not — the exact state `roll_2f` was built at #34 to make impossible, occurring in the very next session.
- **⚠ WHAT I GOT WRONG (four; ELEVENTH consecutive session, and TWO were green readings that meant nothing).** ★ My first mutation run reported **all three mutants SURVIVED** — they had crashed on an import before reaching a single assertion; *"survived"* and *"never ran"* are indistinguishable unless you look at the output ([[instrument-without-a-consumer]], self-inflicted) · ★ I nearly accepted a **`/tmp/build.log` dated 2026-07-28 19:55**, unwritable and baked into the sandbox image, reading `✅ all generators ran`, as **this** session's build · I re-derived the boot-first ordering as my own judgement when **commit `6f92f08` had already recorded it** — *"the prerequisite is measuring the boot"* — found only incidentally via `git log`; **RETRIEVAL-FIRST is standing and I did not run it at the opener** · I wrote a pointer to `_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md` **ds-025 into the gate and the log before ds-025 existed** — a forward reference asserted as fact, caught before commit.
- **⬛ STILL OPEN, DAVE'S — four, and the first is the only unruled part of ds-023:** **(1) what happens ABOVE 63** — he ruled the band and the marked tolerance and nothing beyond; the gate keeps the pre-#36 shape there and a pinned assertion fails if a later session quietly fills the silence · **(2) ds-025's remedy** — the (a)/(b)/(c) choice · **(3) the read chain's SCOPE** — does the `DO THIS FIRST` worklist join the priced chain (+3,415 tape, honest) or leave the header region · **(4) the #35 LS offloads + `LS:LIFECYCLE` de-materialise + the deferred register**, untouched this session and now three sessions old.
- **⬛ OWED TO THE FRESH WINDOW (this was a flush, not a wrap):** ritual steps **1b–5b** · **step 2d roll** (this file now carries LATEST + **3** priors; #34's delta is due in `_LIVE-STATE-ARCHIVE.md`) · **step 2f stratum for #37** — ⚠ until it runs the new clock check **correctly FAILS** on banner #36 vs stratum #35 · **the #37 DOSSIER (step 1b)**, not written: the arc above is state lines only, and the *why* lives in the chat until someone writes it · **GOOD-MORNING.md untouched, so the next cold reader still opens on #36's banner.**
- **TREE STATE — a second lane of Dave's is live.** Committed `3488332` (LOCAL, unpushed — Desktop is his) on three explicit paths: `knowledge/_capture_gate.py` · `notes/_GAUGE-LOG.md` · `knowledge/_memento-index.json`. ⚠ **Left dirty ON PURPOSE:** `knowledge/_CAPTURE-GATE.md` + `knowledge/_LIVE-STATE-CHECK.md` — their scope count moved **29→31** because it picked up the other lane's two untracked `context-degradation` files; they regenerate cleanly once that work lands. ## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-29 (Wed **morning #36**, OPUS solo, Dave live — ★★ **ds-023's `< 45` had been enforced as a BLOCK that Dave never ruled — it was FAILING THE BAND it existed to steer sessions into** · ★★ **the wrap gate silently degrades to an estimator that UNDER-reports pressure by 414 tape** · ★ **GM's offload relief was already spent at #35 — 647 tape to block** · 🟡 no enactment, deliberately) — "The gate was refusing the band it was built to aim at."
- **⛔ RULED BY DAVE #36 — ds-023 RE-STATED AS A BAND, enacted NOWHERE (that is #37's first job).** **`45–60` is a PREFERRED BAND for the FULL price** — *"front-load + context GM + job + wrap"* — not a threshold: *"the whole 45% was a misunderstanding, it just creates the band… that I'd prefer the full price with wrap to sit in."* **~60 is the line and it is LIVABLE** (*"I can live with it, it's safe-ish"* — where he notices degradation); **63 tolerable, rare, marked.** ⚠ The first read-back — *"45 becomes a WARN, blocking line ~60"* — was **two thresholds, not a band**, and Dave corrected it; the ledger carries the corrected shape. Whole ruling + arc: `notes/_MEMENTO-DECISIONS.md` § ★ #36 · `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-29-the-ceiling-was-never-a-ceiling.md`.
- **★★ FOUND — the enforcement was never Dave's.** ds-023's own header reads *"ruled-in-part #31 in Dave's own words, **enforcement picked #31 delegated**"*: he ruled the NUMBER, a delegated agent picked **FAIL**, and #34's `≤ 45`→`< 45` sharpening was about which side of 45 counts, not whether 45 blocks. ⇒ an honestly-priced job landing in the low 50s — **the intended zone** — had to either mark a `RESERVE SPEND` receipt for a spend that was never over-budget, or be quietly under-priced to fit. **ds-023's own text names under-pricing as the thing its escape hatch prevents; it was manufacturing it.** [[gate-narrows-its-own-rule]] third appearance, first to invert a rule's DIRECTION rather than narrow its region: **`warn ≠ block`**.
- **★★ MEASURED — the gate degrades into an estimator, and it fails UNSAFE.** `_capture_gate.py --wrap` reported GM compactable **10,939 tape** with tiktoken absent *(bytes/3.53 ESTIMATE)* and **11,353 tape** on the same unchanged file after `pip install tiktoken --break-system-packages`. **414-tape swing on the number that gates the wrap, running the WRONG WAY** — a fresh sandbox sees ~414 tape of **phantom headroom** against a 12,000 block. The gate does not refuse; it labels the degradation mid-line and returns a plausible number. **RAISED, not ruled:** size checks should REFUSE without tiktoken — honest UNKNOWN over confident approximation ([[measuring-tool-must-not-guess]]).

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **evening #11**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★★ **ds-018's REMEDY IS RULED BY DAVE: A2 mint dataviz-tier · B2 label-led · C2 the wide fail-loud gate** · ★★ **THE SQUEEZE — the border channel is structurally unable to carry a recessive disabled state, and nobody had measured that** · ★ **the record was WRONG that `--text-disabled` has no `:root`; it does, at `#E1E1E1`, the exact value B-D4 was minted to escape** · ★ **chart snippets are not in canon.css's cascade at all** · review doc render-proven **30 checks · 0 failures ×2 widths, bite red** · NOTHING ENACTED, by his instruction) — "The remedy the record implied was impossible, and the reason was one measurement nobody had taken."

- **★★ RULED BY DAVE — ds-018 A2 · B2 · C2.** From `reviews/DS-018-DISABLED-STATE-2026-07-27-v1.html` (live specimens, three decision controls, contrast computed at render time). Verbatim: *"I've gone with your recommendations but we should probably wrap up and do it in the next window."* **A2** = mint dataviz-tier `--data-control-*` equivalents (siblings of `--data-axis`/`--data-grid`/`--data-series-*`, which already live on chart scopes) · **B2** = label-led (disabled label goes recessive; disabled border returns to `--line`, matching enabled-resting — **accepted cost, ruled with it: the label then carries the whole distinction**) · **C2** = the wide gate (*a declaration referencing a custom property that resolves nowhere in its own scope is a build failure*), the `fail-loud-on-unknown` shape already ratified for `dv-vocab`. ⚠ **C3 (the affordance gate) was NOT rejected on merit — it was not selected**; it stays a live candidate because it catches a resolved-but-wrong ladder C2 cannot see.
- **⛔ STILL UNRULED AND MUST NOT BE INFERRED — THE RECESSIVE VALUE.** The doc offered `#9D9D9D` / `#808080` / `#B5B5B5` / `#6B6B6B` **explicitly as candidates and explicitly NOT as a recommendation** (derivation governance: value promotion is Dave's alone). `#9D9D9D` was only the page's pre-selected preview. **The light/dark pairing is equally unruled.** ⇒ **Enactment must put the value to him; it may not read it off the ledger.**
- **★★ THE SQUEEZE — the finding that produced CALL B and was not in the record.** The remedy the record implied (*"make the disabled border recessive"*) is **structurally impossible**: enabled-resting border = `var(--line)` `#E1E1E1` at **1.31:1**; disabled currently resolves to ink at **17.40:1** ⇒ **the dead control carries 13.3× the contrast of the live one.** Anything quieter than enabled is below the perceptible floor; anything equal erases the distinction. **No third value exists, so the border channel cannot carry this state.** The label channel can — enabled label is ink at maximum contrast, leaving the recessive-but-visible band **B-D4 already ruled acceptable.** ⇒ **channel is upstream of tier, not downstream.**
- **★ THREE CORRECTIONS TO THE RECORD (verified from source, not inherited).** (1) **`--text-disabled` IS declared on `:root`** — `canon.css:350` = `#E1E1E1`, dark twin `#808080` at `:647`. The prior entry's *"zero `:root`"* was true of `--border-disabled` only and got over-generalised to both. ⇒ **"promote to `:root`" is already the label token's state, and it is a source of defect.** (2) `--border-disabled` census **confirmed unchanged** — 29 declarations, ten `.cn-*` form scopes + SC/dark twins, zero chart scopes, zero `:root`. (3) **Chart snippets link `type.css` ONLY and inline their own spine** (`Chart-bar.reference.html:51–52`) ⇒ **`canon.css` is not in the chart cascade at all, so a `:root` fix reaches a real app page and leaves the snippet — what every render-proof measures — broken.** ⚠ (4) **Value drift FLAGGED not corrected:** B-D4 ruled `#808080`; canon ships `--text-on-disabled: #9D9D9D` (`canon.css:351`) per the B-D6 fold. Both are ledgered, but they disagree, and it collides with the unruled recessive value.
- **Evidence:** review doc + `.REVIEW.html` overlay copy · 2026-07-27 · `knowledge/_render/verify_ds018_review.py` **30 checks · 0 failures at 1180 and 760**, licensed HSBC cut asserted **inside each measured frame**, transitions killed before every computed read, colours parsed and compared **as colours** · 2026-07-27 · **`--bite` red** — declaring the two properties on a COPY resolves the lookup and turns STEP 1 red, so the probe is not blind; canon untouched · 2026-07-27.
- **⚠ PROBE WART BANKED:** first run reported the enabled ratio as `11.31:1`. **The doc was right (1.31:1); the probe was wrong** — a `\d+\.\d+` regex over the table's *flattened* textContent straddled the adjacent `#E1E1E1` cell. **Read cells, never flattened text.** Also: the sandbox cannot `os.remove` under the repo mount, and a cleanup error printed *after* a correct verdict swallowed it — **cleanup runs after the verdict now, and moves to `outputs/` on the same mount.**
- **⬛ NOTHING ENACTED — Dave's instruction, and the gauge was Red (~66%).** No token minted, no gate built, no generator touched. The ruling is the deliverable.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **evening #10**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **DV-D17 IS RENDER-PROVEN: the debt from three sessions is DISCHARGED** · ★ **the old acceptance test was one-sided — an assertion of an ABSENCE, which a full revert also satisfies** · ★ **ds-018 RE-VERIFIED on a clean instrument and it STANDS — and the states are INVERTED, which is worse than reported** · build **60/60 GREEN**) — "A proof that only checks a thing is gone is satisfied by a revert; the missing half was proving it was ever there."

- **★★ DV-D17 — ENACTED · DOM-PROVEN · ✅ RENDER-PROVEN.** `knowledge/_render/verify_dv_d17_render.py`. Licensed HSBC cut asserted **inside the frame being measured**, transitions killed **before the first gesture** (ds-019's lesson, structurally), **real pointer clicks on the real gestures** (LABEL = isolate · SWATCH = check on) — never `classList.add`, which is not a user path. **Six contexts, identical:** snippet @1180/@760 · showroom **light** @1180/@760 · showroom **dark** @1180/@760 (verified genuinely dark — `--ink` `#FFFFFF`, `--line` `#808080` — so it is coverage, not one pane counted twice). **baseline** `rgb(225,225,225)` / `rgba(0,0,0,0)` → **isolated** `rgb(26,26,26)` = `--ink` + `color(srgb 0.101961 … / 0.06)` = 6% ink → **released** back to `rgb(225,225,225)` / `rgba(0,0,0,0)`.
- **★ THE FINDING — A ONE-SIDED PROOF OF AN ABSENCE IS NOT A PROOF.** The specified test was *"no `.dv-legrow` resolves the `.is-solo` treatment after isolate-then-check-on."* That is satisfied by a working fix, a blind probe, a mistyped selector **and a complete revert**. Session #8 ran it and printed `24 checks · 0 failures` while measuring nothing. **The replacement is two-sided in ONE gesture sequence: step 1 proves the treatment CAN be seen (isolate → it paints); step 2 proves it stops.** Step 1 is what makes step 2 mean anything — and it is precisely the half the original lacked. **Generalises past this defect: any proof whose assertion is "X is absent" needs a paired proof that X is detectable when present.**
- **★ THE BITE REPRODUCES DAVE'S SCREENSHOT.** `--bite` on a **neutered COPY** (216-byte DV-D17 release branch deleted; canon untouched, `git status` clean): step 2 fails at both widths with row 1 keeping `.is-solo`, `rgb(26,26,26)` border and 6% ink fill **while three series show** — the black-bordered "B Savings" Dave reported. **Step 1 still passes under the neuter**, which is the whole point: the probe is not blind, the behaviour is broken.
- **★ THE PROBE CAUGHT ITSELF, AND THE RULE IT EXERCISED IS THE ONE INSCRIBED THIS MORNING.** First run went red — *"row 2 paints an ink border with no `.is-solo`"*. **The check was working; the cause was the instrument:** `.dv-legrow:hover` also paints an ink border, and a **real** click leaves the cursor on the row it clicked. Fixed by parking the pointer **and** carrying an OBSERVED `hovered` field, so a hovered row is **named and skipped, never silently filtered**. *(A control that fires may be RIGHT — exhaust that before calling it broken. Here it was right about the pixels and wrong about the cause, and only an observed field could separate the two.)*
- **★★ ds-018 RE-VERIFIED AND IT STANDS — the timing defect did not reach it.** `knowledge/_render/recheck_ds018.py`, settled, pointer parked, 4 contexts: **`--border-disabled` → `''`** · **`--text-disabled` → `''`** · **`border-color` → `rgb(26,26,26)` = `--ink`**. ⚠ **AND IT IS WORSE THAN "DISABLED LOOKS LIKE HOVER" — THE STATES ARE INVERTED:** baseline (Reset **disabled**) → **ink border** · isolated (Reset **enabled and useful**) → `--line` · released (**disabled**) → **ink**. ⇒ **The disabled Reset is the most prominent control in the legend and the enabled one the faintest** — an inversion of affordance, not just a wrong colour. Cause unchanged (the lookup, instance five); **fix shape still Dave's**, and this adds a second cheap gate candidate: *a disabled control may not out-contrast its own enabled state.*
- **Evidence:** `python3 knowledge/_build_all.py` **60/60 GREEN exit 0** · 2026-07-27 · `verify_dv_d17_render.py` green ×6 contexts + `--bite` red ×2 widths · 2026-07-27 · `recheck_ds018.py` 4 contexts · 2026-07-27 · element renders `outputs/_render-env/png/DV-D17-three-states.png` **SEEN** (three legend states, licensed cut) · env staged from cold per `_RUNBOOK-render-verify.md`, **`__dirlock` EPERM appeared exactly as banked — a failure message after a success.**
- **⬛ NOT DONE, deliberately, and the price is stated:** no `_DECISION-HISTORY` dossier — the window ran to ~68% and inscription of the durable record was the priority over narrative. The two findings above are in the ledgers, which are the tattoos.
- **⬛ STILL OPEN, untouched:** ds-018's **fix shape + which gate (Dave's)** · ds-016 · the `CTRL` sweep (ruled YES, not started) · call (4) · ds-017's remedy · ds-012 · DV-D16/D18 · the 15-item ruling batch · the per-member behaviour opt-in schema question · **MEMORY.md compaction (its own small window).**

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **afternoon #9**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **ds-019 WITHDRAWN WITH CAUSE: it was NEVER a defect** · ★ **the fault was the INSTRUMENT — a computed value read in the SAME TASK as a class change is the PRE-transition value** · ★ **DV-D17's render-proof UNBLOCKED; Dave's screenshot question ANSWERED** · build untouched **60/60 GREEN**) — "A false defect spent a full session as canon, and the record was sending the next window after a rule that does not exist."

- **★ ds-019 IS NOT A DEFECT — WITHDRAWN, both beats kept.** `.dv-legrow.is-solo` **(0,2,0), cascade index 4** beats `.dv-legrow` **(0,1,0), index 3**. CDP `CSS.getMatchedStylesForNode`: no `!important`, no inline style, no `attributesStyle`, no keyframes, **no `:is()`/`:where()` list and no `#cb4-legend li` rule.** The "winning rule that does not contain the string `dv-legrow`" **does not exist** — the four-selector census was correct; its premise was false. Confirmed in **six contexts** (snippet 1180/760 · showroom light pane 1180/760 · showroom **dark** pane 1180/760, theme-tracking correctly at `--ink` `#FFFFFF` / 6% white).
- **★ THE MECHANISM — a measured time series, not a reading of CSS.** `.dv-legrow` carries `transition: border-color var(--ease), background var(--ease)` = **0.16s**. before-add `rgb(225,225,225)` / `rgba(0,0,0,0)` · **t=0 same task `rgb(225,225,225)` / `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)`** ← *exactly the pair ds-019 published as proof* · t≈50ms `rgb(145,145,145)` / `oklab(0.217785 … / 0.0241082)` (**mid-interpolation**) · **t≈150ms+ `rgb(26,26,26)` = `--ink` ✓ / `color(srgb 0.101961 … / 0.06)` = 6% ink ✓.** ⚠ **`oklab(…)` serialisation is the signature of an IN-FLIGHT INTERPOLATION, not of a failed declaration.**
- **★ THE TRANSFERABLE FINDING: THE PREDECESSOR'S POSITIVE CONTROL WAS WORKING, AND WAS OVERRULED.** It observed `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)` differing from `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` and passed — and those **are** different states (transitioning-transparent vs static-transparent). Session #8 diagnosed its own control as a string-comparison artefact and dismissed a true signal. The string method was bad **and** its verdict was right. ⇒ **When a control fires unexpectedly, exhaust "it detected something real" before concluding it is broken.** Same family as [[gate-narrows-its-own-rule]] and #7's stale suite — the instrument present, correct-looking, not measuring what it claimed — **but this is the first one INSCRIBED AS A DEFECT, where it then directed work.**
- **✅ DV-D17 UNBLOCKED (still ENACTED · DOM-PROVEN · RENDER-OWED — prove it, do not rebuild it)**; any proof **must settle the transition first** or it reproduces ds-019. **✅ Dave's question answered: the screenshot showed the treatment because the treatment paints. Screenshot right, probe wrong, two sessions. No silent regression, no unprobed context.**
- **★ RULED BY DAVE — RENDER TOOLING GETS A REPO HOME.** `knowledge/_render/cdp_matched_styles.py`. ⚠ The prior handoff's *"the harness is already written — reuse it"* pointed at `outputs/_render-env/probe.py`, and **`outputs/` is `.gitignore` line 45** ⇒ the instruction was **never followable**. New script: CDP cascade enumeration + colours parsed **as colours** + **`--settle off` by default** (injects `transition:none !important` before any class change, so a mid-transition read is structurally impossible); `--settle none` reproduces the artefact on demand. Pothole banked in `_RUNBOOK-render-verify.md`.
- **⚠ ds-018 STANDS, and is NOT re-verified.** Same probe, same session — but a **resting** control, not a post-class-change state, and its census (29 declarations / ten form scopes / **zero** chart scopes) is independent evidence. **"Should not be affected" is not "is not affected" — cheap re-check OWED (§C·4).** Skipped deliberately at ~55% rather than start a fresh measurement hot.
- **Evidence:** `knowledge/_render/cdp_matched_styles.py` · CDP `getMatchedStylesForNode` + `getComputedStyleForNode`, six contexts · 2026-07-27 · time series at t=0/50/150/300/600/1200ms · bite: `.is-solo` deleted from a **copy** reproduces the original numbers exactly, canon untouched · fonts **deliberately not staged** (cascade resolution is font-independent; this measures neither geometry nor paint) · defect `knowledge/_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md` **ds-019 § WITHDRAWAL block** (original kept verbatim below it).
- **⬛ SCOPED BY DAVE MID-WINDOW — "headline only, then commit"** at a ~68% projection. **Dossier, full ritual and the ds-018 re-check deliberately NOT done.** Two unplanned findings, both forked to him as the throttle requires.
- **⬛ STILL OPEN, untouched:** DV-D17's render-proof (**now unblocked**) · ds-018's two gates + fix shape (Dave's) · ds-016 · the `CTRL` sweep (ruled YES, not started) · call (4) · ds-017's remedy · ds-012 · DV-D16/D18 · the 15-item ruling batch · the per-member behaviour opt-in schema question.

records.text:
## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **afternoon #8**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **ds-018 CONFIRMED BY MEASUREMENT: it is the LOOKUP, and it is INSTANCE FIVE — a FORM-tier token consumed from a DATAVIZ-tier scope, never resolved since the day it landed** · ★ **ds-019 NEW: `.dv-legrow.is-solo` MATCHES, its vars RESOLVE, and it STILL does not paint — so DV-D17's owed render-proof is VACUOUS and would have read green forever** · ★ **MY OWN PROBE PRINTED 24 CHECKS / 0 FAILURES AND WAS WRONG** — the positive control compared computed colours as STRINGS · **NOTHING BUILT, Dave chose log-and-stop at the fork** · build unchanged **60/60 GREEN**) — "The proof was green because the thing it was watching for has never happened, and could never happen."

- **★ ds-018 — HYPOTHESIS PROVEN, COMPETING EXPLANATION ELIMINATED, BY MEASUREMENT NOT BY READING CSS** (which is what the entry demanded). `getComputedStyle` on the **disabled** Reset, licensed HSBC cut, `document.fonts.check` asserted true FIRST, **four contexts — snippet AND showroom pane (via `page.frames`), at 1180 and 760** — all four identical: **`--border-disabled` → `""` (does not resolve)** · **`--text-disabled` → `""`** · `--ink` → `#1A1A1A` (resolves, so the context is not broken) · **`border-color` → `rgb(26,26,26)` = ink = the `:hover` value** · `color` → `rgb(26,26,26)`. ⇒ IACVT → `border-color` falls to `currentColor`, `color` falls to `inherit`; **both roads end at ink.**
- **★ AND THE CENSUS IS STRONGER THAN THE MEASUREMENT: the token is not set to an ink-ish value, it is NOT SET AT ALL where a chart can see it.** `canon.css` declares `--border-disabled` **29×**, on ten **form** scopes (`.cn-input-fields` · `.cn-dropdown` · `.cn-amount-input` · `.cn-date-picker` · `.cn-date-range-picker` · `.cn-file-upload` · `.cn-form-layout` · `.cn-secure-entry` · `.cn-textarea` · `.cn-time-picker`) + their SC/dark twins — **ZERO on any chart scope, ZERO on `:root`**. The four consuming snippets (`Chart-bar`/`combo`/`donut`/`line`) declare it **0×** and use it 1× — same for `--text-disabled`. ⇒ **A FORM-TIER TOKEN READ FROM A DATAVIZ-TIER SCOPE. It has never resolved on a chart, in any theme, at any width, and every gate was green throughout.**
- **⚠ THE FIX IS WIDER THAN THE SYMPTOM DAVE REPORTED.** `--text-disabled` fails in the same breath and is **masked** (colour is inherited, so it lands on ink, which *reads* plausible) — a fix aimed only at `border-color` leaves a second silent lookup live. Belongs in the **generator + a gate**, never a `canon.css` hand-patch (block is replicated per chart family and regenerated). **Two gate candidates, neither built:** the entry's own *no control's disabled treatment may resolve to its hover treatment* · **and the cheaper, wider one — fail loud when a declaration references a custom property that resolves nowhere in its own scope** (the *fail-loud-on-unknown* shape already ratified for `dv-vocab`). ⚠ **CONFIRMED ≠ FIXED.**
- **★ ds-019 NEW — AND IT IS THE FINDING THAT STOPPED THE WINDOW.** Applying `.is-solo` **directly**, no gestures, no behaviour code: element **matches** `.dv-legrow.is-solo` ✓ · `--ink` → `#1A1A1A` ✓ · `--line` → `#E1E1E1` ✓ · yet computed **`border-color` → `rgb(225,225,225)`** (= `--line`; the declaration did not win) and **`background` → `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)` = FULLY TRANSPARENT**, not 6% ink. **Control: the identical `color-mix` written literally on a sibling `<div>` in the SAME subtree → `color(srgb 0.101961 0.101961 0.101961 / 0.06)`** — the mix itself is fine. **A rule that matches, whose variables resolve, overridden on BOTH declarations.** The census enumerated only selectors containing `dv-legrow` (4, none able to beat `(0,2,0)`) ⇒ **the winning rule does not contain that string** — `:is()`/`:where()`, `.dv-leg > li`, `#cb4-legend li`, `!important`, inline/animated all plausible, **none checked. DO NOT GUESS IT.**
- **⚠⚠ CONSEQUENCE: DV-D17's RENDER-PROOF IS UNATTAINABLE AS SPECIFIED AND WOULD HAVE READ GREEN FOREVER.** The acceptance test is *"no `.dv-legrow` resolves the `.is-solo` treatment after isolate-then-check-on"*. **No row resolves it at ANY time** — before, during, or after isolation — so the assertion is permanently true for reasons unrelated to DV-D17, **and would have survived a complete revert of the fix.** ⇒ **DV-D17 stays ENACTED · DOM-PROVEN (108/108 + 27/27, three neutered controls) · RENDER-OWED.** ⚠ **Do NOT mark it render-verified on a green run of the probe as written.**
- **⚠ A QUESTION THAT IS DAVE'S, LOGGED NOT CHASED:** if the treatment has never painted, **the screenshot behind DV-D17 showed something** — either a context not yet probed, or the treatment worked once and regressed silently. Worth knowing which.
- **★ WHAT I GOT WRONG, AND IT IS THE TRANSFERABLE PART: THE FIRST RUN PRINTED `24 checks · 0 failures` AND WAS A FALSE GREEN.** The probe carried a positive control *precisely* to stop a vacuous pass — the solo row's paint must differ from baseline or the probe is blind. **It compared computed strings.** Solo bg serialises `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)`, baseline `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` — **textually different, visually identical (both fully transparent)** — so the control "saw a difference" and passed. **Caught BY EYE reading the JSON, not by the check.** ⇒ **Compare computed colours AS COLOURS (parse r/g/b/a), never as strings; a control that can pass on a serialisation difference is not a control.** ⚠ This happened *inside the probe written to honour* [[stale-reading-failure-mode]]'s sibling rule *"assume your probe is wrong in the direction that reads as green"* — **the rule was quoted in the file's own docstring and still did not prevent the failure it names**, because the control was checked for existence, not for sensitivity. Same shape as #7's stale-suite finding, and as ds-018/ds-019 themselves: **the instrument was present, correct-looking, and not measuring what it claimed.**
- **✅ HARNESS RE-PROVEN FROM COLD, runbook verbatim, no new steps** — pip→mount · TLS env · `chromium-headless-shell` (non-zero exit after a successful download = expected host-validation) · 11 libs via `apt-get download` · two-alias fontconfig · render. **NEW POTHOLE BANKED:** `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` on the outputs mount ends the install with **`EPERM: operation not permitted, rmdir '__dirlock'`** — **same species as the host-validation exit: a failure message following a success. Check the cache, proceed.**

- **★ THE HEADLINE, and it is Dave's: INSTRUMENT FIT IS A THIRD AXIS.** Angle (1) of the FLOATED idea (*compare what a rule SAYS against what its gate DEMANDS*) **would NOT have caught `aid-009`.** The rule names *"a minimum 44×44px target area"*; the gate calls its check *"target size"* — **the vocabulary matches; the narrowing is in the INSTRUMENT.** A static regex observes a *declared box*; the rule is about a *target*. They stop tracking each other the moment the property is expressed through a mechanism (expander · token · transform) — and **the gate goes QUIET, not RED.** ⇒ **Sits ON TOP of ADR-0016, not inside it:** PROVEN/CLAIMED/UNPROVEN ask *"is there a check and can it fail?"*; this asks *"is it looking at the right thing?"* — **a check can be PROVEN and still measure a proxy that doesn't track its rule.** dv-004 was the *narrowing* case; `aid-009` is the *instrument* case, and it is larger.
- **★ ds-015 — ADOPTING THE CORRECT MECHANISM IS WHAT REMOVES A COMPONENT FROM THE CHECK.** `_validate_a11y.py` does not mis-measure the `::before` expander; it **`continue`s**, deferring to a "render axis" that **does not exist** (the hit-area gate is still PENDING DAVE SIGN-OFF). **MEASURED: 67 snippets · 1,869 selectors skipped by the `CTRL` vocabulary · 14 eligible · 7 exempted · 7 actually measured.** Verdict **0 failures, exit 0**; 64 of 67 snippets use `::before`. **The diamond proves it three times** (`.dv-leg-sw.sw-diamond`, 8×8 + `rotate(45deg)`): out of `CTRL` scope · expander is `min-width:var(--hit,44px)` and the regex reads literal `(\d+)px` · `::before` → exempt. ⚠ And its real defect is a **transform** consequence — **no static box measurement can see that in principle**; `elementFromPoint` caught it by hand in the legend wave.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **later morning #2**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **ds-014 CALLS (a)+(b) RULED BY DAVE, ENACTED AND PROVEN BY RENDER** · ★ **the gate had NARROWED ITS OWN RULE — dv-004's text is mechanism-neutral, its gate demanded a stroke** · **`dv-vocab` NEW BLOCKING: unknown chart types can no longer skip silently** · build **58/58 GREEN**; register **PROVEN 3→4, UNPROVEN 53→52**; 🟡 AMBER ~58% wrap) — "Dave declined my recommendation and asked why I'd made it. Checking cost one grep and he was right — the donut's stroke mechanism doesn't transfer to a plot with gridlines behind it. Chasing *why* I'd recommended it found the real defect: the gate had quietly narrowed a mechanism-neutral rule into one mechanism, so it wasn't just failing to catch the error, it was the source of it."

- **★ DV-D14 — dv-004 is satisfied by GEOMETRY on gridded plots (Dave's ruling, against my recommendation).** I proposed the donut's 2px `stroke="var(--page)"`. Dave: *"I prefer the geometry the border will obscure gridlines, may I know why you recommend borders?"* **He was right and the check took one grep: `cb5` carries 5 full-width `.dv-grid` lines behind the columns; the donut carries none.** An SVG stroke straddles its path, so 2px puts 1px OUTSIDE each rect — painting over every gridline down both sides of all 4 columns. ⇒ **A surface-coloured stroke only simulates separation when the thing behind it IS the surface.** Enacted **variant A, both ends pinned**: baseline `y=230` and each stack top stay TRUE, the 4px comes out of segment heights. **Accepted cost, stated at ruling time: segments understate 2.0–2.6%, worst on the shortest column.**
- **★ THE FINDING THAT OUTRANKS THE CHART — the gate had narrowed the rule.** dv-004's text is **mechanism-NEUTRAL** (*"minimum 2px separation between colour blocks"*); `_validate_dataviz.py` enforced *"must carry a surface-coloured stroke >=2px"*. Both directions bite: a chart satisfying dv-004 by real geometry **would have FAILED**, and **an agent reading the gate to learn what compliance looks like gets the wrong answer** — which is exactly what happened to me. Dave supplied the governing fact from the KG (*"the gap is only 2px minimum, this is in the dataviz specifications in the KG"*) and then named the class himself → **held as FLOATED in `_FUTURE-STATE.md`** (his exploration, do not build ahead of it). ⚠ Caution recorded there: the consult prints `rulings (5/5 shown, --all for more)` — **it TRUNCATES**, so a forcing function built on it would be a CLAIMED gate with extra steps.
- **★ DV-D15 — `data/text/on-series` MINTED (Dave's promotion).** The keys had declared `var(--page)`: white today only because of where the neutral ramp sits — **a coincidence, not an intent**. New role → `color/grey/white`, **pinned in BOTH modes**, modelled on `rag/text/on-dark`; **deliberately NO alpha channel** (DV-D07 computes contrast from the composite, so an alpha slot is a route to passing on the hex and failing on screen). **type26-013 does NOT collide** — checked, not assumed: *"black/dark-grey on light · white/light-grey on dark"* covers it; the white-only clause is specific to RED grounds.
- **★ THE VOCABULARY HAD FORKED — fixed structurally, not by enumeration.** The corpus carries **both `stacked` and `stacked-column`, both `grouped` and `grouped-column`**, plus `scatter`. Adding three strings would have guaranteed a repeat ⇒ **`DTYPE_CANON` normalises once at read time** + **`dv-vocab` (NEW, BLOCKING) fails the build on any dtype the gate has never heard of**, naming the rules that would have skipped it. Scope-blindness audit: 3 blind values → **"none detected"**. **The dataviz selftest is now WIRED into the build** — it existed and ran only by hand, which is precisely why nothing ever proved dv-004 could fail. 9 new bites, incl. one reproducing the exact ds-014 figure.
- **⚠ A THIRD SILENT-FALLBACK, and it happened AFTER the build went green.** Token minted, generated into `canon.css`, build 58/58 — **and the keys still rendered BLACK at 3.99:1.** The snippet carries a LOCAL MIRROR of the token list for standalone preview and didn't declare the new var; **`fill:var(--undefined)` falls back to the SVG initial value, black, in silence.** Third instance of one class, three different mechanisms: ds-010 (author CSS beat `fill=`) · ds-013 (404 stylesheet) · this. **Through-line: a lookup that misses and reports nothing — and in all three the markup is CORRECT, so no static gate reaches it.**
- **★ PROVEN BY RENDER — `knowledge/_verify_dv_stacked_enactment.py` (NEW, the ADR-0016 P2 proof).** Licensed cut, **snippet AND showroom pane, 1180 AND 760, all four agreeing**: separation **2.00px** on all 8 boundaries; keys white at **5.26 / 5.04 / 4.61:1** vs AA 4.5. ⚠ **The prior handoff predicted "≈5:1"; MEASURED worst case is 4.61:1** (series-3, margin **0.11**) — recorded as measured. **Series-3 cannot be lightened without breaking AA.**
- **⚠ THE PROBE COMMITTED THE ERROR IT WAS WRITTEN TO DETECT — third session running.** First run reported *"no stacked-column figure"* for the showroom; the honest reading was not "the showroom is broken" but **"I queried the top document and the panes are `srcdoc` iframes"**. Last session's probe used `querySelector('svg')` and got the toolbar copy icon. **Standing lesson, earned three times: assume your probe is wrong in the direction that reads as green.**
- **⬛ (d) donut cluster alignment — PARKED on Dave's ruling.** Logged in `_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md`, deliberately NOT fixed; rule it in a session where he can see it live.
- **Evidence:** build `_build_all.py` **58/58 GREEN exit 0** · 2026-07-27 · gate selftest **22/22** incl. 9 new · 2026-07-27 · render proof `_verify_dv_stacked_enactment.py` **ALL ASSERTIONS PASS**, 4 contexts · 2026-07-27 · register `knowledge/_ENACTMENT-REGISTER.md` PROVEN 4 / CLAIMED 20 / UNPROVEN 52 of 76 · 2026-07-27 · ledger DV-D14 + DV-D15 · dossier `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-27-the-gate-that-narrowed-its-own-rule.md`.

Read off the band table, not recalled. **AMBER ~58%** — wrapped deliberately at Dave's "wrap up" rather than starting the remaining 52 P2 proofs hot. **Pre-flight was stated before the render job, per the new rule, and held.**

Advisory on purpose: *a gate that fails 53 rows on day one gets switched off, and a switched-off gate is how we got here.*

## ⏱ ARCHIVED DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon morning, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **LEGEND WAVE CLOSED** (combo + line migrated, 100/100, transitional block deleted, page budget 88%) **+ ds-013 FIXED + GATED: `srcdoc` had killed `type.css` in ALL 49 showroom panes**; build 56/56 GREEN; commit `ba336dc`; 🔴 RED ~80% wrap) — "Dave opened with a bug report rather than a lane — the chart legend labels were too big, all except Reset. Fixed and gated, then the two remaining lanes landed and the transition closed."

- **★ ds-013 — LIBRARY-WIDE TYPE OUTAGE IN THE SHOWROOM, found by DAVE'S EYE.** `gen_showroom.py` delivers each snippet to its pane iframe via **`srcdoc`**, and a srcdoc document inherits the **parent's** base URL — so `<link href="../canon/type.css">`, correct from `knowledge/snippets/`, re-resolved against `showroom/` to a non-existent path. **type.css 404'd in all 49 panes that link it**; every `.t-cm-*` composite and selector binding was inert. Measured (computed styles, licensed cut): legend label **16px/400 → 12px/500**, key **→ 12px/700**. **Reset was correct only because its snippet CSS hard-codes `font-size:12px`** — the exact asymmetry Dave reported. **Longstanding, OBSERVED not inferred:** the pre-migration snippet renders **13.333px** (button UA default) under the same condition. Full record: `knowledge/_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md` ds-013.
- **★ FIXED + GATED (`gen_showroom.py`).** `rebase_payload_urls()` re-points payload URLs; **a rebased URL whose target does not exist FAILS THE BUILD** — the condition is gated, not the instance. 6-bite `--selftest` wired as build step 56. ⚠ Anti-false-fix pinned by bite 2: an injected `<base href>` would re-base fragment URLs and **break every icon sprite in the library**. The selftest caught a genuine defect in the fix itself (dropped `?query`/`#fragment` suffixes) before it shipped.
- **★ LANES ②③ — THE WAVE IS COMPLETE.** Chart-combo (`cc1`, 2 series) + Chart-line (`cl2`, 3 series) on DV-D11. **Combo keeps ONE shape modifier** (circle, for its line series) — two mark types on one plot make shape a real non-colour channel, where bar's were dropped for being all rects. **Line earns the full circle/square/diamond set.** ⚠ **The divvy did not name this:** the diamond's `rotate(45deg)` also rotates its 44px hit-area `::before`, standing the target on its corner — **counter-rotated**, proved with `elementFromPoint` probes at 1180 and 760.
- **★ THE VERIFY SUITE WAS LYING BY CONSTRUCTION.** `_verify_dv_legend_members.js` had baked in bar's **three** series and the **literal string "Current"**; it crashed on a 2-series member and would have passed any member whose series happened to share the name. Generalised to per-N invariants with names read off the markup. **54 → 100 checks, bar's 54 unchanged.** *(Standing lesson: a suite that hardcodes one member's data cannot verify the next one — and it fails in the direction that reads as green.)*
- **★ TRANSITION CLOSED** (`_check_legend_migration.py` exit 0): transitional block deleted from `dv-behaviour.js` (**15,771 → 13,004 B**), dead `.dv-legend*`/`.dv-legbtn*`/`.dv-quiet` CSS deleted from all four members. **Page budget 31,490 → 28,723 B (88%).** ⚠ **The prior handoff predicted 85% / 27,768 B — 88% is the MEASURED figure.** Recorded as measured, per that handoff's own Correction 2.

Real fix = the already-open per-member behaviour **opt-in** (schema change, Dave's).

Dave chose "lanes now, sweep after"; the lanes consumed the window. **Build the sweep as a numeric assertion** (see `GOOD-MORNING` §DO-FIRST) — an eyeball pass authored at this gauge is the failure mode, not the mitigation.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **later morning #4**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **CALLS (1)(2)(3)(5) RULED BY DAVE; the 465-rule INSTRUMENT-FIT pass is BUILT, RUN and WIRED** · ★ **ds-016 — 7 LIVE GATES CITE RULES THE INDEX CANNOT SEE: 698 anchors declared, 465 indexed, 265 invisible — `aid-009` among them** · build **60/60 GREEN**; 🔴 RED ~72% at ritual) — "He said 'most robust methods', so the tool was built so it could not guess. Then bite 1 failed on its first run and the failure was the finding: the rule the a11y gate enforces is not in the rules index at all."

- **★ CALL (3) DELIVERED — `knowledge/_build_instrument_fit.py`, the instrument ladder at corpus scale.** I0 STATIC (source bytes) → I1 DOM (parsed tree) → I2 RENDER (computed/composited/geometric) → I3 EYE (judgment, never a defect). **Sits ON TOP of ADR-0016:** the register asks *is there a check and can it fail*; this asks *can it observe the property at all*. Generated `_INSTRUMENT-FIT.md` + `_instrument-fit.json`, **11 bites**, wired **advisory** as build steps 58 (selftest) + 59 (report) per the P3 posture.
- **★ MEASURED: 465 rules — UNDER-INSTRUMENTED 12 · UNGATED 165 · UNTAGGED 279 · EYE-ONLY 4 · FIT 5.** ⚠ **The limit is stated first, not buried: 279 of 465 (60%) are UNTAGGED**, so **12 is a FLOOR, not an answer.** Deliberately NOT fixed by widening patterns until the report went quiet — that is anti-false-fix #2 in the tool's own header, and it would convert a measured finding into a tuned one. **Two of the 12 are BLOCKING and both are contrast rules with STATIC gates:** `dv-016` (chart titles/axis/gridlines) and `icon-011` (*"icons require 4.5:1 in all instances"*). **Contrast is a COMPOSITED property** — a static parse reads the declared hex, not what lands on screen. Same class as ds-010 · ds-013 · DV-D15, now four proven instances.
- **★ ds-016 — THE FINDING NOBODY WENT LOOKING FOR, and it is ds-015 INVERTED.** Bite 1 asserted the ds-015 ground truth and returned `None`: **`aid-009` is not in `_rules-index.json`.** Chasing it: `guidelines/*.md` declares **698** rule anchors; the index holds the **465** carrying an enforcement-destiny tag; the other **265 are invisible** to the index, `_consult.py`, the enactment register and this pass — and **7 of them are cited by a live gate as its authority** (`aca-003` · `aca-004` · **`aid-009`** · `aid-020` · `avd-006` · `axs-003` · `nam-001`). `aid-009` is Dave's 2026-07-03 hit-area ruling, named 5× by `_validate_a11y.py`; **its anchor line simply never got a destiny tag.** Mirror image in the same family: **`icon-005` (BLOCKING, 44×44 target) IS indexed and NO gate names it.** ⇒ There the gate couldn't see the component; **here the INDEX can't see the rule** — markup correct, lookup fails, nothing reports it. ⚠ **The 265 are excluded BY DESIGN, not by bug; the defect is the SILENCE.** LOGGED not fixed — the remedy is call (4)'s discussion, unruled.
- **⚠ THE BITES CAUGHT THREE DEFECTS IN MY OWN TOOL, ALL ON FIRST RUN.** (1) A crude bare-word probe read **three** gates as RENDER — `_validate_proforma.py`, `_validate_token_tiers.py`, `_validate_type_composites.py` — matching the word **chrome**, as in *mono*chrome and *demo-*chrome. ⚠ **Wrong direction: it makes gates look STRONGER than they are**, which in a fitness audit buys silence. (2) `icon-005` came out **FIT** with `_build_instrument_fit.py` itself as the evidence — **a register that NAMES a rule was counting as a check that ENFORCES it**; fixed with `NOT_A_GATE` (this file + `_build_enactment_register.py`, same exposure). (3) bite 1's failure ⇒ ds-016. **Third session running for "assume your probe is wrong in the direction that reads as green".**
- **★ CALL (2) RULED — ADOPTION-TIME AND SWEEP ARE COMPLEMENTARY (Dave: *"You're right about 2 they are complimentary"*).** He asked to be corrected; **his lean was right, the framing was the thing that needed correcting.** Adoption-time captures intent from whoever knows *why* — **counted** data, not inferred — but is blind to everything already shipped (**64 of 67 snippets already carry the `::before` expander; it would find zero**), and a *missing* declaration is silence. Sweep is retroactive and needs no cooperation — **proven the same day, it found the 7 dangling citations laid down months apart** — but reports late and **its own coverage is unmeasured** (blind to 265 rules, can't classify 279 more; nothing revealed that until a second check was built). ⇒ **The only way to detect a MISSING declaration is to sweep for it**, so the sweep is what makes adoption-time enforceable. Held shape: **adoption-time forcing function + a sweep narrowed to one job, finding undeclared adoptions.**
- **Evidence:** build `python3 knowledge/_build_all.py` **60/60 GREEN exit 0** · 2026-07-27 · selftest `_build_instrument_fit.py --selftest` **11/11** · 2026-07-27 · register `knowledge/_INSTRUMENT-FIT.md` (465 rules) · 2026-07-27 · capture gate **13 in scope / 0 fail / 0 warn** · 2026-07-27 · defect `knowledge/_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md` **ds-016** · ideas `_FUTURE-STATE.md` § KG forcing-function **Exploration beat 2** · dossier `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-27-the-index-cannot-see-the-rule.md`.
- **⬛ STILL DAVE'S:** **(4)** consult enforcement column — *"I lean fix, but this probably needs a discussion"*, **NOT ruled**; the `5/5 shown` denominator is separable + trivial and was **NOT done** (Red budget). **(5)** `CTRL` vocabulary sweep — **ruled YES, NOT started.** **NEW:** invest in the pattern table (279 UNTAGGED)? · ds-016's three remedies (fail-loud / tag the 7 / both).
- **🔴 Gauge: RED ~72% at ritual (ESTIMATE ±15%).** Read off the band table. Pre-flight was stated before the build and ran ~10 points over — the miss was ds-016, an unplanned finding chased mid-job. **Wrap reserved in advance per the three-term rule.**

## LIVE — current truth (in force)

### ⭐ TYPE and BOX are SEPARATE — T-D12, RULED + VERIFIED across 21 files (2026-07-18)
- **Two lists, two questions.** `.t-cm-<size>` = TYPE (family, size, weight, **`line-height:1`**) —
  **safe to bind anywhere.** `.t-cm-slot` = BOX (`display:inline-flex`, `align-items`, `min-height`,
  cap-trim) — **opt-in**, bound ONLY where the element already declares a flex display.
- **`--slot` carries the slot height on the type composite.** A custom property is inert unless read,
  so a type-only binding has no box consequence. That is what makes the two lists independent.
- **`line-height` is TYPE, not BOX** — Component tier *is* "single-line at line-height 1". This was
  not the question the queue asked and it is the one that decided the batch: with line-height in the
  box, type-only bindings silently DROPPED the `/1` the old shorthand carried.
- **Cap-trim reaches elements that lacked it, and the shift is ACCEPTED** — refusing it would leave
  two classes of button in canon.
- **The slot test stays conservative.** "Already declares flex" is the OBSERVED condition `.btn` met,
  not a theory. **Slotting anything else is a per-component decision with its own diff, never a
  mechanical sweep.** Widening it is a ruling.
- Evidence: 13/21 pixel-identical, 0 page-height changes, real HSBC Univers. Ledger:
  `_proforma/_TYPE-DECISIONS.md` **T-D12**; sheet `reviews/TYPE-BOX-SPLIT-2026-07-18.html`.
  Validation state: **unaudited**.
- **METHOD, reusable:** the `NO_SNAP=1` isolation control in `apply_type_bind.py` separated diffs the
  binding CAUSED from diffs T-D10 INTENDED. **A diff you cannot attribute is not evidence.** Reach for
  a control before reaching for a verdict.

### Type binding — RULED + PROVEN on one component (2026-07-18)
- **Mechanism = (d) selector-list extension, HAND-MAINTAINED.** A component binds by being appended
  to its composite's selector list in `canon/type.css`. Plain CSS: no generator, no build step, no
  markup change. `type-bindings.json` + orphan gate = an OPTIONAL later upgrade, **explicitly
  deferred — do not build**. Ledger: `_proforma/_TYPE-DECISIONS.md` T-D9.
- **`.t-cm` is variant D.** Cap-trim sits on the **ELEMENT**; the former required `.txt` child is
  **GONE**. `inline-flex` + `align-items:center` centres the cap box in a taller slot — an
  `inline-block` variant TOP-ALIGNS and is wrong. Observed in real HSBC Univers. Supersedes the
  07-17 composite.
- **⚠️ LOAD ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING.** `.t-cm-button` and `.btn` are both specificity 0-1-0 → source
  order decides. **`type.css` must load BEFORE component CSS.** Not yet gated.
- **Delivery = `<link>`, NOT inlining.** The portable unit is the PROJECT, not the file (Dave: *"the
  entire project must be portable… a package, pulled from a repo"*). The 49-file inline sweep was
  solving a problem that does not exist.
- **`type.css` is HAND-AUTHORED.** The "generated" header was false provenance; removed.
- **Bound so far: `.btn` (selector-list) + Countdown `.num` (CLASS).** **T-D14 (2026-07-19):** new rung
  `.t-cm-figure-3` (24px/500) added to the ramp; the countdown numeral is the **first composite bound in
  MARKUP** — via a class on the element, because bare `.num` can't go global (collides with `.cn-table td.num`).
  Zero-visual-change (500 = shipped value). **ASSERT-003 retired** (clears_when met). ⚠️ **The BULK binding
  mechanism for the remaining ~338 stays OPEN** — this was one collision-forced case, NOT a general ruling. Ledger: T-D14.
- **Unchanged from 07-17:** CSS cap-trim · 4px slot · slot min `ceil(cap + 2·descender)` snapped to
  4px · descender guard baked INTO the slot · stacks use `gap`, **never padding**.

### RAG — amber SOLVED, background/glyph split (2026-07-18)
- **Two tokens per hue: `background` (fills) + `glyph` (icons, arrows, text).** Red/green/blue hold
  the SAME value in both roles; **only amber diverges**. Ledger: `_proforma/_RAG-DECISIONS.md`.
- **`amber/background` = `#F0B13A`** — ink on it 9.16. **`amber/graphic` = `#C58900`** — 3.02 on
  white, 6.25 on `#111`; required by `{#dv-016}` (≥3:1 series fills, blocking).
- **Rule 1 — amber is always paired with black text. Rule 2 — amber is not a DIRECTIONAL delta
  colour**; it remains valid for status and tolerance.
- **White is the RAG text colour universally; dark-text variant DROPPED** (R-D1) — amber the sole
  exception, always was.
- **`#000000` retained in the KB as brand source of truth**; `#1A1A1A` = digital black for screens;
  `#1D1D1D` dropped; `#333333` canon, stays.
- **Incumbent RAG values NOT deleted** — retired into a future legacy theme. Tombstone, keep.
- **R-D4 (2026-07-18): matting rungs RULED — green + blue matted 15%** (`#2B7E4F` / `#306EC6`),
  red as-is, one level across both. **Role tokens PROMOTED** into `semantic-colour.json` as
  `rag/<hue>-background` + `rag/<hue>-glyph` (additive; incumbents untouched; zero components
  rebound yet — rebinding waits for the blast-radius gate). Green promoted **light-only**: the
  contrast gate refused the known-failing incumbent dark (3.37) — dark leaf lands with the
  dark-green ruling. Gate model gained `RULED_PAIR_EXCLUSIONS` (white text × amber fill is
  forbidden by rule 1, so the audit no longer tests it). Ledger: R-D4.
- **★ DARK SET LOCKED (2026-07-19, R-D5…R-D11).** Full arc: `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-19-rag-colour-halation-ramp.md`.
  Dark-mode RAG (mode-stable for red/amber; per §note below for green/blue): **breach `#B92F1E` white ·
  watch `#F0B13A`/`#C58900` black · healthy `#43AD6F` black · info `#5F92B9` black** (cyan-shifted for
  astigmatic legibility). Weight uniform Medium 500. Marks icon/label-paired (never bare coloured text on

  red `#B92F1E`/white + amber `#F0B13A`/`#C58900` mode-stable. **NO lines** (R-D12 A, aesthetic); **black text on states**

  ruled fine (I over-raised it; Dave corrected). **★ Per-mode PROVEN, not asserted:** exhaustive search shows no single
  green/blue keeps green›blue on both grounds (loud=darker on white, lighter on dark). Reconciled table + arc: ledger

  render RAG as dots (glyphs, bind incumbents, R-D6 fine) + chips (tints); the `-background` fills await the §1
  manifestation pick. **Both amber rules still unenforced (gate owed).**
- **★ FOUR-THEME ARCHITECTURE — R-D15 (2026-07-19).** ONE token store + ONE baseline library, toggling **4 themes:
  Apollo Legacy · Mono · Console (UI) · Supercharge (SC)**. Components bind theme-agnostic roles; theme override sets
  supply the hex. **Apollo Legacy** alone carries the teals AND the HSBC brand `color/grey/100–800`. **The baseline we
  build now = Apollo Mono, "very mono": monochrome throughout, colour ONLY in RAG + data-vis.** Broader colour/theming
  build PARKED ("deal with colours later"). Ledger R-D15; memory `four-theme-architecture`.
- **★ Apollo Mono grey ramp = `color/mono/1…15`** (2026-07-19, R-D15). Dual-end brightness curve (γ=1.7, 15 stable
  index steps, black→white), packing resolution to both ends, thinning mid-greys; `#1A1A1A` = `mono/4`. Keys are index
  (theme-remappable); per-step brightness in the token `$description`. In `colour.json` + canon; build green. Tuner:
  `reviews/APOLLO-MONO-GREY-CURVE-2026-07-19-v2.html`. **Grey-tint standing check** (memory `feedback-grey-tint-check`):
  surface greys (`#333`=`grey/800`, `#767676`=`grey/600`) before changing — Dave usually rules black, but confirm.

- **★ Digital black `#1A1A1A` = the new `#000`** (Dave 2026-07-19) — GENERAL, not just the reverse-text halation

- **⭐ Unified DS knowledge-graph + ingestion, done right** (from ADR-0003 defer). The whole corpus is

Stood up 2026-07-05 as a fixed, repeatable sequence — the enforcing script (`_capture_gate.py`)
was BUILT 2026-07-26 under the Memento dream-pass lane (§ "The gate" below; rulings
`notes/_MEMENTO-DECISIONS.md`). Anchor: ADR-0007

records.head: When to run this
records.text:
## When to run this

At the end of **every** session that changed project state — decisions, rulings, code, docs. Skip
only for pure Q&A sessions that touched nothing. If in doubt, run it; it's cheap.

**Two-tier mid-session firing (ruled 2026-07-21, `_RUNBOOK-context-gauge.md`):** at **Amber** run
**step 1 only** — a light `_LIVE-STATE.md` spine-flush, session continues (no `GOOD-MORNING`, no
rename, no fresh window); at **Red** run the whole thing 1→5 + open fresh.

**Also run it mid-session at the IN-FLIGHT STOP LINE — `60 − the priced wrap`, NOT at a reading of 60**
(~50–52 at today's 8–10 point wraps; `_RUNBOOK-context-gauge.md` § ds-023). ⛔ **60 IS WHERE THE WRAP
HAS FINISHED, NOT WHERE IT STARTS.** ⚠ **THIS LINE USED TO SAY "when the gauge reads Red (≥60%)" and
that was WRONG** — it put the entire wrap price on top of 60, which is #28's and #29's recorded cause.
Corrected #54 on Dave's own words: *"the 60% is the total with the wrap included, it was never supposed
to be 60 plus wrap."* ★ The stop line MOVES with the wrap price and is not its own constant — an
expensive wrap must stop the session earlier. Don't wait for a natural end.
The gauge (`_RUNBOOK-context-gauge.md`) exists precisely to fire this ritual *while there's still
clean budget to author the handoff well*; a `GOOD-MORNING.md` written at 95% full is the confidently
wrong handoff we most want to avoid. Red cue line, ready to use:
> **Title this chat: `<retrospective title>` — context is Red (~NN%). Running the capture ritual, then
> open fresh with: `<forward title>`.**

records.head: The steps, in order (1, 1b, 2, 2c, 2d, 2e, 2f, 2g, 3, 4, 4b, 5, 5b)
records.text:
## The steps, in order (1, 1b, 2, 2c, 2d, 2e, 2f, 2g, 3, 4, 4b, 5, 5b)

*Steps **2e** and **2f** were added 2026-07-27 (GM-D1…D9, `notes/_MEMENTO-DECISIONS.md` § GM
growth-contracts ruling). They extend the 2c/2d pattern — cap + archive sibling + verbatim move +
EXIT CHECK — to the two `GOOD-MORNING.md` regions that had no roll rule and were therefore absorbing
~97% of the file's growth. **The architecture in one line: every GM section declares a growth contract
(what it may contain · cap · roll target · retirement test); §A alone is standing and uncapped.***

1. **Refresh `_LIVE-STATE.md`** — and its siblings where touched: `_FUTURE-STATE.md` (ideas /
   side-quests / resurrection candidates) and `_DECISION-HISTORY/` (narrative >10 lines relocates
   there at write time — the spine discipline, ruled 2026-07-18). Update LIVE / SUPERSEDED-DEAD /
   OPEN / PLANNED-TARGET for anything that changed. Bump the `*Last refreshed:*` line —
   ⚠️ **take the date from running `date`, never from the session's own belief**: the T-D12 handoff
   self-dated "2026-07-19" while its commits landed 07-18 evening; commit timestamps caught it.
   Confident false inscription of something as small as a date still poisons the record.
   If a ruling killed something, tombstone the artifact **and** log the propagation gap in the
   same pass (supersession discipline, non-negotiable per `AGENTS.md`).
   **Feed the sign-off register (dream-pass v2 P4, ruled 2026-07-26):** if the session leaves a
   review artefact awaiting Dave (a `reviews/*.html`, a proposal brief, a showroom pane), its PATH
   goes into `knowledge/_REVIEW-SIGNOFF.md`'s running list in the same pass — not only into the
   banner. Banners compact (2c/2d); the register is the durable queue.
   **Save cited uploads (dream-pass v2 P5(b), ruled 2026-07-26):** any uploaded/attached document
   the record will CITE gets written into the repo (`notes/`, verbatim + field lines) in the same
   session — a chat-only attachment is an un-retrievable citation. Worked precedent both ways: the
   `lamish-…` transcript was saved and nothing that cites it ever blocked; the convergence note was
   not, and its `-v2` blocked three consecutive sessions on "re-attach".
1b. **Author the session NARRATIVE DOSSIER — the why and how, not just the what.** *(Added 2026-07-19,
   Dave: "a narrative dossier would be good for many chats, I like recording the why and how not just
   saving the what — maybe this should be part of the closing ritual." Model example:
   `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-19-rag-colour-halation-ramp.md`.)*
   For any session that produced real **reasoning** — a method, a multi-step decision arc, findings, a
   design exploration — write a dated `_DECISION-HISTORY/YYYY-MM-DD-<thread>.md` that records the ARC:
   the why behind each finding, the dead-ends and corrections, how the thinking moved, not only the final
   values. **This complements, never replaces, the terse records:** the ledgers / ADRs / `_LIVE-STATE`
   hold the WHAT (the ruling + its pin); the dossier holds the WHY and HOW (the narrative that the ledger
   line can't carry and that evaporates with the chat). Group by finding, each with its rationale; end with
   the resolved state and what's still open. Obey the archive rules (`_DECISION-HISTORY/README.md`): **lands
   whole, dated from `date`, never silently edited after; both-way links** to its spine entry and ledger.
   **Trigger:** substantive/reasoning-heavy sessions. **Skip** for trivial or purely mechanical ones — the
   test is "would a cold reader need to know *why* we did this, not just *what* we landed on?" If yes, write it.
   **Provenance fields (added 2026-07-26, Memento §4.1 — D1a/D2, `notes/_MEMENTO-DECISIONS.md`):** every
   new dossier — and every new dated note in `notes/` — carries two plain lines in its header block at
   write time, mechanical, never authored as prose:

   ```
   provenance: <session-id> · <YYYY-MM-DD>     # id from the session's own path; date from `date`, never belief
   status: observed | inferred | ruled | floated | standing
   ```

   `ruled` is reserved — writable only with a pointer to its ledger/ADR entry after the value
   (promotion is Dave's alone). `standing` = long-lived Dave-owned hypothesis, neither floated-and-
   forgotten nor ruled. **Enforced by `_capture_gate.py` in every build** (blocking, files dated
   ≥ 2026-07-26 — no corpus retrofit).
2. **Write/refresh `GOOD-MORNING.md`.** The cold-start entry point for the *next* session — write it
   for a reader with zero memory of this one. **Required structure, in order:**
   - **The two names first** (see step 4b) — rename + next title, at the very top.
